item.title: TinyLM: Small Language Models That Punch Above Their Weight
item.dc:creator: A. Researcher
item.content:encoded:
We present TinyLM, a family of tiny LLM architectures with 100M parameters.

Distillation from a larger teacher model yields strong reasoning for a small language model.

Version 2

Extended discussion: quantization, pruning, and mixture-of-experts routing all contribute to the compact footprint, and we benchmark extensively on reasoning tasks across many languages and domains.
